_purpose: Canonical decision: exactly one mission MUTATION authority. Discovery flagged 'four competing mission surfaces'; on reading the code only one mutates mission state — the rest are read proxies, UI clients, or (bin/MISSION.js) not a mission engine at all.
rationale: harness_service.js owns mission/job lifecycle (POST /harness/job). Missions are jobs surfaced via toMission(). app/api/harness/missions and app/api/mission-data expose GET only.

bin/MISSION.js.note: 11-line manifesto poem, not a mission engine — discovery miscount
